content: Pancreatic diabetes, also referred to as Type 3c diabetes, requires careful monitoring in individuals with pancreatic conditions. The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends that individuals with chronic pancreatitis undergo annual diabetes screenings to detect potential glucose metabolism abnormalities. Additionally, for those who have experienced an episode of acute pancreatitis, it is advised to perform diabetes screening 3 to 6 months following the acute event to assess for the development of diabetes.
